Method of Attack: Creates a hidden admin user named 'wpsecuritypatch'
Sends victim information to attackers' command and control server (C2) at 'wpgate.zip'
Downloads a base64-encoded backdoor payload saved as 'wp-autoload.php' in the website's webroot
Backdoor provides file management, SQL client, PHP console, command line terminal, and server environment info
Hides itself from the list of installed plugins
Attack Vector: Phishing email impersonating WordPress security advisory with fake plugin download
